headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 26, 2026**
article:
The Houston Astros suffered a dominant 8-0 loss to the Detroit Tigers, who were led by Keider Montero's strong pitching performance. In other news, the Cincinnati Reds secured a 6-4 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, while the Texas Rangers edged out the Toronto Blue Jays in a close game.

Injuries and availability continue to impact teams across the league. The Chicago Cubs placed Hoby Milner on the 15-day injured list due to appendicitis, while the Toronto Blue Jays placed Jesús Sánchez on the 10-day injured list with a right ankle sprain. The Boston Red Sox also placed Marcelo Mayer on the 10-day injured list with a bone stress reaction to the left ulna.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place in the past 24 hours. The Chicago Cubs acquired LHP David Peterson from the New York Mets in exchange for 3B Cole Mathis. The Houston Astros traded RHP Jayden Murray to the Chicago Cubs for 1B Cameron Sisneros.

top_news.title: **Astros Fall to Tigers in Dominant 8-0 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros were shut down by the Detroit Tigers, who won 8-0 behind a strong pitching performance. Keider Montero led the way for the Tigers, throwing 7.0 innings with 3 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Pirates 6-4**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 6-4 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Brock Burke earning the win in relief. Noelvi Marte led the Reds' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall to Orioles in 1-3 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals suffered a 1-3 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, with Trevor Rogers earning the win after 6.1 innings of work. Rogers struck out 7 batters and allowed just 1 earned run in the contest.

top_news.title: **Rangers Take Down Blue Jays in Thrilling 5-4 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers edged out the Toronto Blue Jays in a close game, winning 5-4. Nathan Eovaldi led the Rangers to victory with a strong 7.0 innings pitched, striking out 9 batters and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Astros Take Down Tigers 8-6**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured an 8-6 victory over the Detroit Tigers in their recent matchup. Jeremy Peña and Yainer Diaz were among the key contributors for the Astros, while Isaac Paredes and Riley Greene had notable performances for the Tigers.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Shut Down Yankees 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 4-1 victory over the New York Yankees, with Max Schuemann and Masataka Yoshida contributing to the winning effort. Ceddanne Rafaela and Anthony Seigler also made notable impacts in the game.

top_news.title: **Cubs LHP Hoby Milner Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Chicago Cubs left-handed pitcher Hoby Milner has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to appendicitis, effective retroactive to June 26, 2026.

top_news.title: **Cubs Acquire Lefty Pitcher in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs have acquired left-handed pitcher David Peterson in a trade. Peterson joins the Cubs after being dealt from the New York Mets.
